title.en: Clarify password-update security and add accessible reveal controls
title.zh: 明确改密安全提示并增加可访问的密码显示按钮

purpose.en: Make SmartLingo password entry easier to verify in all twelve interface languages without weakening Clerk's breached-password protection, and prove that a unique strong password can be changed from the signed-in profile.
purpose.zh: 让 SmartLingo 用户可在全部十二种界面语言中核对密码输入，同时保留 Clerk 泄露密码保护，并验证已登录资料页可使用唯一强密码完成改密。

en: Add an independent Show password / Hide password eye control after every sign-in, recovery, and profile password field.
Keep each password hidden by default and expose twelve-language accessible labels, pressed state, focus treatment, and a 44-pixel touch target.
Explain that a breached-password rejection means the update service is working and recommend a unique random password of at least 12 characters.
zh: 在登录、找回密码和资料页的每一个密码框后增加独立的“显示密码／隐藏密码”眼睛按钮。
密码默认隐藏，并提供十二种语言的无障碍名称、按下状态、键盘焦点及 44 像素触控区域。
明确说明泄露密码被拒绝代表改密服务正常，并建议使用至少 12 个字符的唯一随机强密码。

en: SmartLingo twelve-language sign-in, password registration, password recovery, and Account/Profile password settings.
Clerk configuration, account identity, D1 member data, learning progress, colleges, payments, AI, and media remain unchanged.
zh: 涉及 SmartLingo 十二种语言的登录、密码注册、密码找回及账户／个人资料改密界面。
Clerk 配置、账户身份、D1 会员数据、学习进度、学院、支付、AI 与媒体保持不变。

en: Use one reusable password-input component for current, new, and confirmation values while preserving autocomplete and minimum-length semantics.
Retain Clerk's current-password check and form_password_pwned protection; no password rule, provider setting, or server secret is bypassed.
Cover hidden and revealed states in all twelve interface languages, preserve the exact selected language in profile data, and require all account credential fields to use a visibility control.
zh: 当前密码、新密码与确认密码共用一个可复用密码输入组件，并保留自动填充与最短长度语义。
保留 Clerk 当前密码校验及 form_password_pwned 保护；不绕过密码规则、服务商设置或服务器密钥。
覆盖十二种界面语言的隐藏与显示状态，个人资料保留准确的已选语言，并要求所有账户密码输入都具备可见性控制。

en: Require targeted password tests, the full repository suite, zero-warning ESLint, TypeScript no-emit, verified production build, sensitive-data scan, D1 replay, layout contracts, and shared SmartLingo gates.

Deploy only through GitHub Actions to Cloudflare, then use an isolated test account to reveal fields, change to a generated strong password, sign out, sign in with the new password, and restore the test credential.
zh: 要求密码定向测试、全仓测试、零告警 ESLint、TypeScript no-emit、已验证生产构建、敏感数据扫描、D1 重放、布局合同及 SmartLingo 共享检查通过。
仅通过 GitHub Actions 发布至 Cloudflare；随后使用隔离测试账户显示密码、改为随机强密码、退出、使用新密码重登并恢复测试凭据。

en: SmartLingo continues to reject passwords found in known breach data; this security control is intentionally not relaxed.
No personal password or recovery code is used, logged, stored, or included in release evidence.
zh: SmartLingo 继续拒绝已出现在已知泄露数据中的密码；该安全保护不会降低。
不使用、记录、保存或写入发布证据任何个人密码或找回验证码。

en: Reuse the existing eye treatment already established for protected SmartLingo course entry while adapting contrast for light account and auth surfaces.
Preserve the isolated SmartLingo repository, Clerk application, bindings, GitHub Actions-to-Cloudflare delivery, and user-owned untracked files.
zh: 复用 SmartLingo 受保护课程入口既有眼睛交互，并为浅色账户与登录界面调整对比度。
保留 SmartLingo 独立代码库、Clerk 应用、绑定、GitHub Actions 至 Cloudflare 流程及用户未跟踪文件。
